about_the_game:
A luxury art book for Marco & The Galaxy Dragon fans!

  • 80+ HD pages, featuring fully colored illustrations, sketches, interviews, and more!
  • Alternate costumes and cartoon design drafts!
  • A Q&A with the voice actresses of the whole main cast!
  • Messages and illustrations from the staff!
  • Music lyrics and special illustrations and more...!
